record.paper_title: Closed operator inequalities and open problems
record.original_question: Let H be a complex Hilbert space and let B(H) be the C*-algebra of all bounded linear operators on H. Let N(H) be the class of all normal operators in B(H). For a relation R(S,X) on B(H) x B(H), call a proposition of the form "for every S in D(H) and every X in B(H), R(S,X)" closed in B(H) x B(H) when D(H) is exactly the set of all S in B(H) for which R(S,X) holds for every X in B(H). Determine the closure, in B(H) x B(H), of the operator inequality that holds for every S in N(H) and every X in B(H): ||S^2 X|| + ||X S^2|| >= 2||S X S||.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space and let $B(H)$ denote the C*-algebra of all bounded linear operators on $H$, equipped with the operator norm $\|\cdot\|$. Let $N(H) \subseteq B(H)$ be the class of all normal operators (those $S \in B(H)$ satisfying $S^*S = SS^*$).

Given a binary relation $R(S,X)$ on $B(H)\times B(H)$, say that the proposition
$$ \forall S \in D(H),\ \forall X \in B(H),\ R(S,X) $$
is closed in $B(H)\times B(H)$ when
$$ D(H) = \{ S \in B(H) : \forall X \in B(H),\ R(S,X) \}, $$
i.e. $D(H)$ is exactly the set of all operators $S \in B(H)$ for which $R(S,X)$ holds for every $X \in B(H)$.

It is known that the inequality
$$ \|S^{2}X\| + \|X S^{2}\| \;\geq\; 2\,\|SXS\| $$
holds for every $S \in N(H)$ and every $X \in B(H)$.

Determine the closure, in $B(H)\times B(H)$, of this operator inequality. Explicitly, characterize the set
$$ D(H) \;=\; \bigl\{\, S \in B(H) \,:\, \|S^{2}X\| + \|X S^{2}\| \geq 2\,\|SXS\| \text{ for every } X \in B(H) \,\bigr\}. $$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing the closure of the inequality $\|S^2 X\| + \|X S^2\| \geq 2\|SXS\|$ on $B(H)\times B(H)$ is posed as an open problem in Seddik's 2011 paper "Closed operator inequalities and open problems" (Math. Inequal. Appl., vol. 14). Subsequent works by Seddik and others (e.g. "Operator inequalities and characterizations", arXiv:2005.08299, and related papers on the Corach–Porta–Recht inequality) treat closely related inequalities and provide partial characterizations, but none of the sources located gives the full closure of this specific inequality. The status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Closed operator inequalities and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Paper poses open problems on the closure of operator inequalities, including one for normal operators of the form involving ||S^2X||+||XS^2|| and 2||SXS||.
status_evidence.claim: The closure problem is explicitly listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Operator inequalities and characterizations (arXiv:2005.08299)
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of normal, self-adjoint, and unitary operators via operator inequalities related to the AM-GM inequality.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterizations are given but the closure of the specific inequality is not established there.
